ellipsoid.basis: Umetsu et al. (2015) fit weak and strong lensing, X-ray and Sunyaev-Zel'dovich measurements together with ellipsoidal shells. On the sky: the X-ray gas is concentric ellipses of ellipticity 0.15 +/- 0.03 at position angle 12 +/- 3 degrees (Sect. VII.2, from Sereno et al. 2012) about the X-ray centre 13:11:29.50, -01:20:29.92 (Table 1); the mass has ellipticity 0.29 +/- 0.05 at 11.4 +/- 4.9 degrees about a centroid 0.0 +/- 1.3, -1.9 +/- 1.4 arcsec from the brightest galaxy at 13:11:29.52, -01:20:27.59 (Table 5, weak and strong lensing together). Along the sight line: a shell's half length over its long half axis on the sky (their Eq. 35) is 1.22 +/- 0.24 for the gas and 1.19 +/- 0.37 for the mass in the joint fit (Sect. VIII.2); X-ray and Sunyaev-Zel'dovich data alone give the gas 1.70 +/- 0.29 (Sect. VII.2). The fit puts the long axis 22 +/- 10 degrees from the sight line; no measurement tells its near end from its far one, so it is drawn on the sight line.
